bm_desc: Update on Prior Intimation of Board Meeting relating to fund raise

Pursuant to Regulation 29 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Tuesday, the 1st September, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve issue of Non-Convertible, Non Listed  Debt Securities by way of Private Placement.
To consider Notice of Annual General Meeting, Annual Report, to fix record date etc
To consider and transact such other business matters as may be contained in the intimation of the Board Meeting.
